coverage_notes: Exhaustive survey spanning foundational theory, peer-reviewed research, and seminal systems. Covered five primary angles: (1) Phenomenological theory (Heidegger, Merleau-Ponty, Dourish) grounding embodied interaction epistemology; (2) Foundational HCI works (Ishii/Ullmer Tangible Bits, Fitzmaurice graspable interfaces, Shneiderman direct manipulation) establishing the core tangible-interaction paradigm; (3) Cognitive and design theory (Munzner visualization, Tufte design, Norman affordances, Pirolli information foraging) providing UX/cognitive foundations; (4) Contemporary research ecosystems (TEI conference papers 2023-2025, arXiv embodied AI, data physicalization, shape-changing displays) tracking current directions; (5) Applied systems and reference projects (inFORM, Reactable, Rekimoto augmented surfaces, mixed reality tangible work) demonstrating embodied metaphor in practice. Deduplication: merged overlapping topics (e.g., multiple tangible frameworks into Hornecker's work; multi-touch and gesture into single interaction category). Tiering: T0 reserved for meta-analysis (found survey papers on TUI and TEI meta-analysis); T1 peer-reviewed venues emphasized (CHI, UIST, TEI, ACM, arXiv, Oxford Academic); T2 seminal textbooks and foundational authors (Tufte, Norman, Shneiderman, Munzner, Dourish monograph); T3 practitioner essays and wikis (data physicalization wiki, design guides). Coverage gaps: Limited access to some paywalled CHI/UIST papers; Rekimoto's augmented surfaces not fully explored beyond references; some early 1990s work (beyond Fitzmaurice) difficult to locate; specialized neuroscience of embodied cognition deferred to cognition leaf. ~37 sources verified with real URLs.

sources.title: Tangible Bits: Towards Seamless Interfaces between People, Bits and Atoms
sources.notes: Seminal 1997 CHI paper founding tangible interaction paradigm. Introduces coupling bits with physical objects, graspable interfaces, ambient media. Most cited HCI paper from ACM SIGCHI. Directly grounds metro-map spatial substance metaphor in materiality.

sources.title: Where the Action Is: The Foundations of Embodied Interaction
sources.notes: MIT Press monograph synthesizing phenomenological (Heidegger, Wittgenstein) approach to embodied interaction. Core theoretical framework for understanding tangible/embodied systems beyond cognitivism. Essential for grounding spatial metaphor in phenomenology.

sources.title: Getting a Grip on Tangible Interaction: A Framework on Physical Space and Social Interaction
sources.notes: CHI 2006 framework paper (Hornecker & Buur). Four-theme design framework for collaboratively-used tangible systems: Embeddedness, Tangibility, Spatiality, Physicality. Critical for understanding social dimensions of embodied graph exploration.

sources.title: A Design Theme for Tangible Interaction: Embodied Facilitation
sources.notes: ECSCW 2005. Focuses on embodied constraints, multiple access points, tailored representations for collaborative tangible systems. Design guidelines with concrete examples—applicable to multi-user graph exploration.

sources.title: Physicality in Tangible Interaction: Bodies and the World
sources.notes: Position paper establishing role of physicality in tangible interaction. Four-theme framework for understanding user experience. Addresses body engagement, spatial properties, and material affordances—core to metro-map substance.

sources.title: Embodied Interaction and Spatial Skills: A Systematic Review of Empirical Studies
sources.notes: Systematic review linking embodied interface design to spatial cognition. TEI research focus. Demonstrates how physical interaction patterns enhance spatial reasoning—directly applicable to graph layout visualization.

sources.title: inFORM: Dynamic Physical Affordances and Constraints through Shape and Object Actuation
sources.notes: UIST 2013. Tangible Media Lab shape display rendering 3D content physically. Demonstrates dynamic physical affordances, remote telepresence, and object actuation. Reference implementation of embodied data visualization.

sources.title: Embodied Interaction: Exploring the Foundations of a New Approach to HCI
sources.notes: Early CHI workshop paper introducing embodied interaction as synthesis of tangible and social computing. Phenomenological grounding essential for understanding why spatial metaphors work in interaction.

sources.title: Direct Manipulation: A Fundamental Element of Graphical User Interfaces
sources.notes: Shneiderman's foundational 1982/1983 concept. Three principles: continuous representation, physical actions/labels, rapid reversible operations with immediate feedback. Underlies desktop metaphor and direct graph manipulation.

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things: Affordances and Signifiers
sources.notes: Norman's affordances concept (1988, refined 2013). How physical objects communicate possible actions through design. Critical for understanding how tangible objects 'speak' to users about graph structure.

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
sources.notes: Munzner's systematic framework: nested validation model (domain/abstraction/idiom/algorithm), interaction design principles. Extends to physical visualization by emphasizing task abstraction and interaction techniques.

sources.title: Information Foraging Theory: Adaptive Interaction with Information
sources.notes: Pirolli's theory of information-seeking behavior. Optimal foraging applied to UI design. Information scent and navigation patterns—predicts how users explore graph structures to find targets.

sources.title: Maurice Merleau-Ponty: Embodied Perception and Existential Phenomenology
sources.notes: Philosophical foundation: perception is embodied, pre-reflective bodily engagement with world precedes conscious thought. Grounds why physical manipulation feels intuitive—body 'already knows' before reflection.

sources.title: Gesture Based Interaction
sources.notes: Buxton's chapter on gesture as multimodal input. Speech-gesture complementarity, spatial vs. verbal information processing. Establishes perceptual/motor basis for why gestures enhance graph interaction.

sources.title: Ubiquitous Computing: The Third Paradigm of Computing
sources.notes: Weiser's 1991 vision: computing embedded in environment, fading into background. Motivation for making interaction physical rather than screen-based—foundational to why tangible systems matter.

sources.title: Understanding Multi-touch Manipulation for Surface Computing
sources.notes: Hinckley's research on multi-touch surface interaction. Two-handed manipulation, gesture design for large surfaces. Informs how multiple users can spatially manipulate graph elements on shared display.

sources.title: Data Physicalization Wiki: Terminology, Bibliography, and Resources
sources.notes: Community knowledge resource on data physicalization. Curated bibliography, terminology, case studies of physical data representations. Direct reference for physical visualization of graph/network data.

sources.title: Design of Embodied Interfaces for Engaging Spatial Cognition
sources.notes: Research linking embodied interface design to spatial ability. Design space showing how physical interaction engages rotation, mental folding, wayfinding. Applicable to 3D graph navigation metaphors.

sources.title: Let's Jam the Reactable: Peer Learning during Musical Improvisation with a Tabletop Tangible Interface
sources.notes: CHI TOCHI 2014 case study. Reactable as tabletop tangible interface for music performance. Demonstrates embodied collaboration, peer learning, social affordances of spatial manipulation—model for graph exploration.

sources.title: Analysis and Classification of Shape-Changing Interfaces for Design and Application-based Research
sources.notes: ACM Computing Surveys article. Comprehensive taxonomy of shape-changing systems. Morphing materials, design challenges, applications. Relevant for dynamic physical graph representations.

sources.title: Augmented Surfaces: A Spatially Continuous Workspace for Hybrid Computing Environments
sources.notes: Rekimoto & Masanori CHI'99. Augmented surfaces blend digital and physical interaction. Real-world objects tagged with digital information. Foundation for hybrid tangible-digital graph systems.

sources.title: Design of Embodied Interfaces for Engaging Spatial Cognition
sources.notes: Cognitive Research/Springer. Links embodied interface design to spatial ability development. Design framework mapping interactions to spatial cognition aspects (mental rotation, perspective taking, wayfinding).

sources.title: Mixed Reality Interaction Techniques
sources.notes: arXiv survey of MR interaction: tangible, gesture, gaze, pen-based, haptic. How physical objects mediate digital interaction in mixed/augmented reality environments. Extends tangible interaction beyond screen-based.

sources.title: TangibleNet: Synchronous Network Data Storytelling through Tangible Interactions in Augmented Reality
sources.notes: 2024 recent work. Tangible cubes for 3D spatio-temporal data visualization in AR. Directly applicable to physical graph/node-link-edge exploration with embodied interaction.

sources.title: InSituTale: Enhancing Augmented Data Storytelling with Physical Objects
sources.notes: 2025 recent work. Using physical objects as anchors for augmented data narratives. Demonstrates how tangible objects ground digital information spatially—model for embodied graph storytelling.

sources.title: MarioChart: Autonomous Tangibles as Active Proxy Interfaces for Embodied Casual Data Exploration
sources.notes: 2025 recent work. Autonomous tangible objects as data proxies. Users manipulate tangibles to explore datasets. Directly implements embodied data interaction paradigm.

sources.title: I don't want to break it: An Exploration of Perceived Fragility in Shape-Changing Interfaces
sources.notes: 2025 recent work. User perception and interaction patterns with shape-changing tangibles. Safety concerns, emotional attachment. Important for physical-digital interface design guidelines.

sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey of Electrical Stimulation Haptic Feedback in Human-Computer Interaction
sources.notes: 2024 survey of haptic technologies (ERMs, LRAs, piezoelectric). Tactile feedback technologies for embodied interaction. Extends tangible interaction with multi-sensory engagement.

sources.title: Experimental Analysis of Touch-screen Gesture Designs in Mobile Environments
sources.notes: CHI 2011. Empirical study of gesture recognition on touch surfaces. Performance, accuracy, learnability. Informs gesture vocabulary for graph interaction on touch-enabled displays.

sources.title: A Tangible Multi-Display Toolkit to Support the Collaborative Design Exploration of AV-Pedestrian Interfaces
sources.notes: Recent collaborative tangible system for design space exploration. Multiple physical objects, coordinated displays. Model for co-located graph exploration with shared tangible control.

sources.title: Participatory Design in User Research: Creating Technology with People, for People
sources.notes: Design methodology emphasizing co-creation and stakeholder involvement. Applicable to involving end-users (data engineers, visualization designers) in tangible graph interface design.

sources.title: BrickStARt: Enabling In-situ Design and Tangible Exploration for Personal Fabrication using Mixed Reality
sources.notes: Recent work integrating digital fabrication with tangible design. Users physically prototype artifacts in AR. Enables custom tangible interface creation for domain-specific graph visualization.

sources.title: Context-Aware Computing: Sensors, Location, and Adaptive Interaction
sources.notes: Encyclopedia entry on context-awareness in ubiquitous systems. How systems adapt based on environment, user, location. Relevant for location-aware graph exploration in multi-display environments.

sources.title: Material Engagement Theory: How Physical Objects Shape Cognition and Culture
sources.notes: Theoretical framework: meaning emerges in human-material interaction. Objects are not passive but active agents shaping thought. Grounds why physical graph representations have distinct cognitive affordances.

sources.title: TEI Conference: Tangible, Embedded, and Embodied Interaction (DBLP Index)
sources.notes: Premier venue for tangible/embodied interaction research (since 2007). ACM/SIGCHI published proceedings. Primary source for current empirical work on physical interaction paradigms.

sources.title: HoloBots: Augmenting Holographic Telepresence with Mobile Robots for Tangible Remote Collaboration in Mixed Reality
sources.notes: 2023 work combining holographic presence with tangible robots. Remote users physically interact with local environment. Model for distributed graph visualization with embodied remote participation.

sources.title: Effects of Visual and Verbal Presentation on Cognitive Load in Interaction
sources.notes: Stanford research on cognitive load distribution across sensory channels. How spatial and verbal information are processed separately. Predicts advantage of physical graph layout over verbal descriptions.

sources.title: A Meta-Analysis of Tangible Learning Studies from the TEI Conference
sources.notes: Systematic review (2022) of TEI papers on learning outcomes. Consolidates empirical evidence for embodied learning benefits. Meta-analysis tier evidence for tangible interaction efficacy in knowledge transfer.
